description: What the suite of the Hub's MCP server must notice (docs/MCP-SERVER.md, P6 ext-17): the gate (Host, Origin, a browser page's request, the two rate-limit buckets, path, token, body limit, a refusal keeps no socket), the log and its summary of refusals, the token store, the setting, the SDK pins, the provider's tools, and the start and stop in hub.mjs.

mutations.name: S1-host-unchecked
mutations.what: the Host header is not checked (DNS rebinding)

mutations.name: S2-host-any-port
mutations.what: the Host check is the SDK's port-agnostic one only

mutations.name: S3-origin-unchecked
mutations.what: the Origin header is not checked

mutations.name: S4-origin-any-local
mutations.what: any localhost origin is accepted (the dashboard's, another port)

mutations.name: S5-no-rate-limit
mutations.what: the rate limit never refuses

mutations.name: S6-rate-limit-off-by-one
mutations.what: one request more than the maximum passes

mutations.name: S7-window-never-resets
mutations.what: a client that hit the limit is refused for ever

mutations.name: S8-retry-after-in-ms
mutations.what: Retry-After is given in milliseconds

mutations.name: S9-any-path
mutations.what: every path is served, not only /mcp

mutations.name: S10-no-token-served
mutations.what: a request without Authorization reaches the SDK

patches.old: if (!match) return refuse(401, 'Unauthorized: this MCP server needs its access token.', { 'www-authenticate': REALM });

mutations.name: S11-token-not-verified
mutations.what: any token is accepted

patches.old: const authorized = match !== null && verifyToken(match[1]) === true;

mutations.name: S12-no-challenge
mutations.what: a 401 without WWW-Authenticate

mutations.name: S13-scheme-case-sensitive
mutations.what: `bearer` (lower case) is refused

mutations.name: S14-loose-header
mutations.what: extra spaces and text after the token are accepted

mutations.name: S15-body-limit-dropped
mutations.what: the Hub's body limit is not given to the SDK (its 4 MiB default applies)

mutations.name: S16-legacy-rejected
mutations.what: 2025 clients (initialize) are refused

mutations.name: S17-all-interfaces
mutations.what: the listener binds every interface

mutations.name: S18-log-shows-url
mutations.what: the log shows the URL (query and path) as the client sent it

patches.old: const shownPath = pathname === MCP_SERVER_PATH ? MCP_SERVER_PATH : '(other path)';

mutations.name: S19-log-shows-authorization
mutations.what: the log line carries the Authorization header

mutations.name: S20-close-waits-for-clients
mutations.what: close() waits for the connections of clients instead of closing them

mutations.name: S21-tools-unsorted
mutations.what: the provider's order is served as it came

patches.old: return list.sort((a, b) => (a.name < b.name ? -1 : a.name > b.name ? 1 : 0));

mutations.name: S22-duplicates-allowed
mutations.what: a duplicate tool name is not refused

mutations.name: S23-any-schema
mutations.what: an input schema that is not an object schema is accepted

mutations.name: S24-annotations-dropped
mutations.what: the provider's annotations do not reach the client

mutations.name: S25-no-input-validation
mutations.what: arguments are not checked against the input schema

mutations.name: S26-cache-hint-changed
mutations.what: the list says it may be cached for a minute

mutations.name: S27-hub-ignores-switch
mutations.what: startHubMcpServer listens although the switch is off

mutations.name: S28-dashboard-port-allowed
mutations.what: the dashboard's port is accepted for the MCP server

patches.old: if (current.port === null || current.port === dashboardPort) return fail(

mutations.name: S29-token-not-redacted
mutations.what: a new token is not registered with the log redactor

mutations.name: S30-port-in-use-unnamed
mutations.what: a busy port is reported as a generic listen failure

mutations.name: S31-workspace-tool
mutations.what: the Hub's provider (mcpProfileProvider since ext-19) exposes one more tool beside hub_status to a new token

mutations.name: S32-browser-allowed
mutations.what: a request a browser page made (Sec-Fetch-Site) is not refused

mutations.name: S33-browser-by-mode
mutations.what: Sec-Fetch-Mode alone counts as a browser (every Node client is refused)

mutations.name: S34-typed-address-refused
mutations.what: Sec-Fetch-Site: none (an address the owner typed) is refused as a page

mutations.name: S35-one-bucket
mutations.what: token-less requests are counted in the bucket of the owner's client

mutations.name: S36-buckets-swapped
mutations.what: authorized requests get the small bucket, token-less ones the large one

mutations.name: S37-refusal-keeps-socket
mutations.what: a refused client keeps its keep-alive connection

mutations.name: S38-every-refusal-logged
mutations.what: every refusal writes its own log line

mutations.name: S39-no-flush-on-close
mutations.what: close() drops the pending summary of refusals

mutations.name: S40-window-never-resets-statuses
mutations.what: after a window, a status already seen is never logged in full again

patches.old: seen = new Set(); counts = new Map(); started = null;

mutations.name: S41-summary-uncounted
mutations.what: the summary says one refusal, whatever the number

mutations.name: S42-anonymous-default-large
mutations.what: the default token-less bucket is as large as the authorized one

mutations.name: T1-verify-any-prefixed
mutations.what: any token with the prefix verifies

mutations.name: T2-rotation-keeps-old
mutations.what: rotate() does not replace the digest in memory

mutations.name: T3-token-in-clear
mutations.what: the token is written unsealed

mutations.name: T4-128-bit-token
mutations.what: the token has 128 bits

mutations.name: T5-ensure-recreates
mutations.what: every start makes a new token

patches.old: if (this.#hash !== null) return { created: false, token: null };
patches.new: if (false) return { created: false, token: null };

mutations.name: T6-bad-digest-accepted
mutations.what: a digest that is not 64 hex characters is loaded

mutations.name: T7-reveal-unchecked
mutations.what: reveal() shows a sealed copy that is not the token of the digest

mutations.name: C1-on-by-default
mutations.what: the MCP server is on by default

mutations.name: C2-variable-ignored
mutations.what: CHATMCP_MCP_SERVER decides nothing

mutations.name: C3-port-3006
mutations.what: the reserved port 3006 is accepted

mutations.name: C4-privileged-port
mutations.what: a port under 1024 is accepted

mutations.name: C5-default-port
mutations.what: the default port is not 3008

mutations.name: C6-set-overrides-variable
mutations.what: a saved choice is written while the variable decides

mutations.name: C7-saved-port-wins
mutations.what: the saved port beats CHATMCP_MCP_SERVER_PORT

mutations.name: K1-version-unpinned
mutations.what: a server package of another version is loaded

mutations.name: H1-hub-never-starts
mutations.what: hub.mjs never starts the MCP server

mutations.name: H2-hub-never-closes
mutations.what: hub.mjs does not close the MCP server when it stops

mutations.name: H3-hub-crashes-on-failure
mutations.what: a failed start of the MCP server stops the Hub

patches.old: catch (error) { return fail('unavailable', error?.code ?? 'mcp_runtime_invalid', error?.message ?? String(error)); }
